name: duskfleet
description: Local AI agent orchestration, scheduling, observability & evaluation platform on top of Claude Code

scripts.build: npm run build -w @duskfleet/core && npm run build -w @duskfleet/mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @duskfleet/core && npm run typecheck -w @duskfleet/mcp
scripts.check: npm run check:public && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck -w @duskfleet/web && npm test
